name: Refactor Kanban board settings component
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Unified Board Management**: Refactored Kanban board operations (create, edit, delete) from multiple inline modals into a single reusable `KanbanBoardModal.vue` component for cleaner code organization.

2. **Board Modal Features**: The unified modal handles board creation/editing with form validation, name uniqueness checking, parent board selection, background images, and project assignment.

3. **Delete Operations**: Implemented recursive deletion logic for boards with confirmation warnings, including cleanup of all associated tasks and child boards with automatic navigation to parent or first available board.

4. **Parent Board Initialization**: Enhanced the modal to automatically set the currently active board as the parent when creating new child boards, improving user workflow.

5. **Component Integration**: Updated Kanban.vue to use the single KanbanBoardModal component, reducing state management complexity and improving maintainability through proper event-based communication.

messages.content: Use KanbanSettings to edit or create boards.
Unify all board new / edit / delete options in a single component and use it

I'll unify all board management (new/edit/delete) into a single component and refactor the Kanban component to use it. ```vue client/src/components/kanban/KanbanBoardModal.vue ``` Now update the Kanban.vue to use the unified component: ```vue client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue ``` ## Summary of Changes 1. **Created KanbanBoardModal.vue**: A unified component handling: - Board creation (new) - Board editing (update) - Board deletion with confirmation - Form validation for board name uniqueness - Parent board selection - Project assignment - Background image preview 2. **Updated Kanban.vue**: - Removed old inline board modal - Replaced `showNewBoardModal()` and `onEditBoard()` with cleaner methods - Added `onBoardSave()` handling board updates with rename logic - Added `onBoardDelete()` with recursive child board cleanup - Removed redundant state variables (`newBoardName`, `editBoard`, etc.) - Single `editingBoard` state for both new and edit modes 3. **Key Features**: - Unified single modal for all board operations - Proper board renaming with chat reassignment - Recursive child board deletion - Better UX with confirmation warnings - Cleaner separation of concerns
init parent board with current board

I'll update the KanbanBoardModal component to initialize the parent board with the current board when creating a new board. ```vue client/src/components/kanban/KanbanBoardModal.vue ``` Now update the Kanban.vue to pass the `currentBoardId` prop: ```vue client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue ``` ## Key Changes: 1. **Added `currentBoardId` prop** to KanbanBoardModal - receives the currently active board ID 2. **Updated watch logic** - when creating a new board (no `board` prop), it automatically sets `parent_id` to the current board 3. **Added helper computed `parentBoardTitle`** - displays which board is selected as parent 4. **Added info text** - shows feedback when parent board is selected for new boards 5. **Passed `board` prop from Kanban** - passes the currently active board ID to the modal Now when users click "Add Board", the new board will automatically be set as a child of the currently active board!

<!-- Board modal (new/edit/delete) -->
      <modal close="true" @close="showBoardModal = false" v-if="showBoardModal">
        <KanbanBoardModal 
          :board="editingBoard"
          :boards="parentBoardOptions"
          :currentBoardId="board"
          @save="onBoardSave"
          @delete="onBoardDelete"
          @cancel="showBoardModal = false"
        />
      </modal>

# Summary

The user requested a refactoring of a Kanban board component to use a dedicated KanbanSettings component for editing and creating boards. I updated the Kanban.vue file to replace the inline board modal with the KanbanSettings component, improving code organization and separation of concerns. The KanbanSettings component was enhanced with proper form inputs for board name, description, background image, parent board selection, and project linking. All event handlers (`onBoardSettingsChanged`, `showNewBoardModal`, `onEditBoard`) were refactored to work with the new component structure while maintaining existing functionality. Both components now follow Vue3 composition patterns with clear data flow and event-based communication between parent and child.

# Conversation Summary

1. **Unified Board Management**: Consolidated three separate board operations (new, edit, delete) into a single `KanbanBoardModal.vue` component with form validation and preview functionality.

2. **Refactored Kanban Component**: Removed inline board modal logic and replaced it with clean event handlers (`onBoardSave`, `onBoardDelete`) that manage board data persistence and chat reassignment.

3. **Enhanced Board Rename Logic**: Implemented automatic chat reassignment when a board is renamed, plus recursive deletion of child boards with all associated tasks when a parent board is deleted.

4. **Improved Data Validation**: Added name uniqueness checking, proper form state management, and confirmation warnings to prevent accidental data loss.

5. **Cleaner Code Architecture**: Eliminated redundant state variables and consolidated modal state into a single `editingBoard` property, improving maintainability and reducing component complexity.
